plaatsen.tekst: And he called the name of that place Bethel: but the name of that city was called Luz at the first.
So Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan, that is, Bethel, he and all the people
And Jacob said unto Joseph, God Almighty appeared unto me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed
And goeth out from Bethel to Luz, and passeth along unto the borders of Archi to Ataroth,

And the border went over from thence toward Luz, to the side of Luz, which is Bethel, southward; and the border descended to Atarothadar, near the hill that lieth on the south side of the nether Bethhoron.
